author: Caroline Barghout
description: According to court filings, Melody Bryant was not the only one who initially failed to recognize killer Jesse Van Rootselaar was "genuinely dangerous." The motion says records show the shooter shared her plans widely and had even "received encouragement from other online contacts."
title: Alleged Tumbler Ridge shooting co-conspirator asks court to revoke detention order

author: Sheena Goodyear
description: Search parties with helicopters, K-9 units and heat-seeking drones scoured the rural dessert community of Eloy, Ariz. for hours looking two-year-old Vella Campillo after she wandered away from her backyard — all to no avail. Then Jay Stewart found her hiding in a bush.
title: 'I'm not a hero,' says Arizona man who found lost toddler alone in the desert

author: Yasmine Hassan
description: Based on testimony from health-care workers, Physicians for Human Rights Israel says there’s been a 350 per cent increase in violence against Palestinian health workers by settlers and the Israeli military. Israel denies the report's claims.
title: Rights group details 'surge' in violent attacks on Palestinian health-care workers

description: Canada's public safety minister announced Monday that Masar Badil had been added to the country's terrorist entity list, as an alias for Samidoun, a group which was added to the same list in 2024.
title: Canada adds Masar Badil group to terrorist entity list, citing status as alias for Samidoun

description: Facing eight charges and a court application used when there is a “fear of terrorism offence,” Matthew Collins was allegedly making threats against a mosque.
title: Court holds N.L. man over fear he will commit terrorist acts after threats against mosque

author: Ozten Shebahkeget
description: A teen girl accused of planning to kill a child at her former Winnipeg elementary school was radicalized online and had a romantic fantasy about an American school shooter, a court heard before the teen was granted bail last week.
title: Girl, 14, planned random killing of child at her former Winnipeg elementary school: Crown

author: Murray Brewster
description: The Defence Department will top up the budget of the cadet and junior ranger programs to allow weekend training and other activities to continue into the new year, Defence Minister David McGuinty said on Monday.
title: Defence Department tops up cadet program after outrage over cancelled activities

author: Christine Pagulayan
description: Jennifer Lopez said being Latina limited her early acting opportunities, prompting her to create roles for herself — a claim that drew online criticism because of her high profile and extensive career.
title: Jennifer Lopez says being Latina limited her early acting roles. Not everyone agrees

description: An Iranian singer and four members of her production team have each received 74 lashes after being sentenced for "offending public decency ‌by producing and publishing obscene and immoral content online," an Iranian news website said on Monday.
title: Iranian singer subjected to 74 lashes for performing without her hijab

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: A chaotic scene unfolded at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport Saturday as a father and daughter were detained by masked immigration officers while boarding their flight bound for L.A.
title: What happened at the Seattle airport? Outrage as ICE arrests man and daughter boarding flight

author: Jessica Wong
description: As Nathan Fielder's You Can See Everything makes its way into cinemas around the globe, the buzzy documentary is proving a big-screen draw with international audiences, too, taking in more than $100 million US at box offices worldwide.
title: You Can See Everything crosses $100M US worldwide at the box office

author: Lauren Scott
description: A Manitoba dentist has pleaded guilty to professional misconduct in connection with the death of Virginia Blatz.
title: Dentist pleads guilty to professional misconduct in 23-year-old's death

author: Darren Bernhardt
description: A Manitoba First Nation is planning to push ahead with a proposed sand mining operation to support a solar panel manufacturing facility, whether the provincial government likes it or not.
title: 'The land is ours': First Nation intends to mine sand in Manitoba through Sio Silica partnership

description: U.S. President Donald Trump said Monday he will defer to a federal appeals court on whether the administration moves ahead with plans to detonate several tons of degraded bomb-making material at an Iowa ammunition plant.
title: Trump tells U.S. army not to detonate unstable, lead-rich explosives without court approval

author: Meghan Grant
description: Three Calgary police officers have been charged with manslaughter two years after an unarmed Blood Tribe man died while in police custody.
title: 3 Calgary police officers charged with manslaughter in death of unarmed Blood Tribe man

description: A United States-led bid to host the 2031 Women's World Cup and a U.K. project led by England for the 2035 edition are set to be confirmed Monday by FIFA.
title: FIFA set to pick American-led bid as 2031 Women's World Cup host

author: Kate Dubinski
description: London, Ont., police have solved a cold case involving the murder of teenager Jackie Dunleavy, who was found strangled in 1968 just blocks from where she went missing after a work shift at a convenience store.
title: London, Ont., police solve 1968 murder of teenager Jackie Dunleavy using genetic genealogy

description: U.S. stock market futures are gaining this morning, following last week's steep sell-off driven by heavy losses for artificial intelligence and technology stocks.
title: U.S. futures climb as technology recovers from brutal sell-off last week

description: A spokesperson for Bell says customers across its network of subsidiaries, including Virgin Plus and Lucky Mobile, were affected by a Nov. 17 breach but no "highly sensitive" information such as credit card numbers or banking information was impacted.
title: Bell says cybersecurity incident affected customers at Virgin Plus, Lucky Mobile

author: Jessica Davey-Quantick
description: The federal government is investing heavily in the North, but some people involved with the cadet program say Department of National Defence is short changing northern kids.
title: Funding cuts leave northern cadets out in the cold

description: The two Americans convicted of murdering Quebec entrepreneur Daniel Langlois and his partner Dominique Marchand in Dominica in December 2023 were sentenced on Monday to life in prison without parole.
title: 2 Americans sentenced to life in prison for murder of Quebec couple in Dominica

author: Alexander Quon
description: The Liberals are running Aaron Kienle, the sitting Mayor of Yorkton, as their candidate in the byelection set for Dec. 7.
title: How will Mark Carney's appeal influence the Yorkton-Melville byelection?

author: Nadeer Hashmi
description: Ranchers say you can still tell when it’s auction day in farming towns: trucks are lined up on the streets, the coffee shops are busy and local commerce surges.
title: Sold! Why live cattle auctions still matter to Alberta ranchers in an era of online bidding

author: Liny Lamberink
description: Mike Williams of Kamloops discovered that the parkas were made in Taloyoak, Nunavut, for the 1974 Arctic Winter Games in Alaska. He's determined to get them back to the northern community where they were made.
title: This B.C. man found some historical parkas at a thrift store — now he's trying to get them back to Nunavut

description: NVIDIA's former CEO is alleged to have been compromised by a Chinese spy. We explore the state of spycraft in the contemporary age.
title: Who's spying on whom and why?

author: Brett Forester, Marnie Luke
description: Manitoba Premier Wab Kinew wants to know who spied on his father for the RCMP, and why. Documents obtained by CBC News reveal the late Anishinaabe leader Tobasonakwut Kinew was under surveillance in the 1960s, an early target in a countrywide infiltration initiative later dubbed the "Native extremism program."
title: Spying on survivors: Why RCMP watched Wab Kinew's father in the 1960s

description: More than 12,000 fans were evacuated from a concert by American rapper Don Toliver after an unknown substance was released in the crowd, British police said Monday.
title: Audience evacuated from Don Toliver concert after unknown substance released in crowd

description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Ukraine was behind an attack that sank a Russian warship off Libya.
title: Zelenskyy confirms Ukraine was behind attack that sank Russian warship off Libya

author: Leigh Anne Power
description: Step inside the Valentine gold mine near Buchans, which is now Atlantic Canada's largest.
title: A gold mine has created a 'little town' in central Newfoundland — and it's about to get bigger

author: Patrick Butler
description: Newfoundland and Labrador’s NDP says the province’s fisheries minister put himself in a “brutal” conflict of interest when he stayed in a castle, then a “luxury” shooting lodge — all on the dime of an aquaculture company — during a trip to Scotland last June.
title: N.L. fisheries minister stayed in Scottish castle, ‘luxury’ shooting lodge on aquaculture giant’s dime

author: Catharine Tunney
description: Big tech is launching its final salvo to scale back the Liberal government's contentious proposed national security legislation, which would change how companies retain and hand over user data to Canadian police and intelligence officers, as it nears its last legislative hurdle in the Senate. Law enforcement agencies are also making a passionate appeal for senators to pass the bill as soon as possible.
title: Big tech, law enforcement make final pitches as Senate considers data access bill's future

description: Guilt or innocence will not be determined by the commission, but it will instead investigate potential miscarriage of justice and may order a remedy, such as a new trial or new appeal.
title: Feds launch recruitment for independent Miscarriage of Justice Review Commission

author: Susan Ormiston, Kate Kyle
description: India's largest slum is being cleared to make room for a modern urban development to include rehabilitated slum housing plus luxury condos and office towers. It's a massive regeneration project, funded by private and public money. But will it work?
title: Inside India's bold plan to transform its largest slum, Dharavi, into a multibillion-dollar development

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Daily use of cannabis has outstripped daily use of alcohol in Canada, with young Canadians at the front of the trend, new data shows. Experts say this generational shift brings some positives, but that many Canadians remain unaware that there are risks with overuse of cannabis.
title: More Canadians are using cannabis daily than are drinking alcohol daily: study

author: Erica Johnson, Ana Komnenic
description: An Ontario man says Canadians are fed up with long waits for telecom customer service. He’s launched a petition urging the federal government to require telcos to connect customers with a human agent within 10 minutes.
title: Petition calls for Canadian telcos to answer customer calls within 10 minutes

author: Benjamin Shingler
description: A Quebec Superior Court judge has suspended the province’s law that made the oath to King Charles optional, ordering that members of the province's legislature must swear allegiance before sitting at the National Assembly.
title: Quebec MNAs must swear oath to the King, judge rules
